company.name: Salt Security
company.shortDescription: Salt Security provides an API protection platform designed to prevent attacks by leveraging machine learning and AI.
company.description:
Salt Security is an API security company based in Palo Alto, California. It provides an API protection platform to prevent attacks, using machine learning and AI to automatically and continuously identify and protect APIs. Deployed in minutes, the platform learns the granular behavior of a company’s APIs and requires no configuration or customization to pinpoint and block API attackers.

The company was founded in 2018 and led by co-founder and CEO Roey Eliyahu and by co-founder & COO Michael Nicosia.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based platform for discovering, inventorying, governing, and protecting APIs, AI agents, MCP servers, and the connections between them.
productsAndServices.name: Illuminate (Agentic Security Platform)

productsAndServices.description: A runtime API protection product that detects and blocks behavioral attacks, business-logic abuse, anomalous activity, and data-exfiltration attempts.
productsAndServices.name: Salt Protect

productsAndServices.description: An external attack-surface discovery service that identifies exposed APIs, AI-agent endpoints, MCP servers, shadow APIs, and related security risks.
productsAndServices.name: Salt Surface

productsAndServices.description: An agentless API inventory product that discovers APIs across cloud accounts and code environments using configuration, metadata, and logs without inspecting live traffic.
productsAndServices.name: Salt Connect

productsAndServices.description: A traffic-analysis product that examines API calls, users, sessions, data flows, and behavior to identify vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, drift, and sensitive-data exposure.
productsAndServices.name: Salt Collect

productsAndServices.description: A security-policy enforcement product for AI coding assistants that guides generated code and validates APIs, MCP integrations, and agents from prompt through deployment.
productsAndServices.name: Salt Code
